name: 37615 · Gray, TN
findings: ZIP 37615 (Gray) has 70 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37615 (Gray) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
